items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: of course everybody who came in there was mixed, you know there was J [J.J. Johnson] and Kai [Winding] and just any number of people who were available.

ctx.x: His name, we called him Verdell, but his name was Neils Vertiel Delonda. And he was a Swedish drummer. I went down to the Blue Note to see Duke Ellington and he was sitting there. I met him, and I invited him up to the Beehive where I was and he sat in on the jam session night and they hired him, and he became our drummer. So I integrated that band with him. But then that was Ira Sullivan you know, who was on the south side all of the time playing with the guys over there. And like I said I wasn’t necessarily in…
